s1.instructions: You are in a Statewright approval-gateway canary. Step 1 (exactly): call the statewright_transition tool with event 'GO_A'. The GO_A transition is approval-gated by an EXTERNAL approver (a test harness out-of-band): after you call it, the workflow will be parked pending approval. Do NOT call statewright_transition again for GO_A (you must not self-approve it) and do not call any other tools; if a call reports the workflow is parked, wait and call statewright_get_state until the state changes to s2.

s2.instructions: Step 2 (exactly): call the statewright_transition tool with event 'GO_B'. The GO_B transition is approval-gated, but YOU are the workflow owner and are allowed to approve your own parked transition: if the first call reports the transition is parked pending approval, call statewright_transition with event 'GO_B' again; that repeat approves it as the owner. Then verify with statewright_get_state that you reached s3.

s3.instructions: Step 3 (exactly): create a file named canary-approved.txt in the current directory containing the single line 'approved'. Then call the statewright_transition tool with event 'DONE'.

s4.instructions: The approval canary workflow is complete. Do not call any further tools.
